originalTitle: Wall Street ends lower as investors weigh data, Middle East tensions
summary: VIDEO SHOWS: n/a STORY: U.S. stocks ended lower on Friday, with the Dow, S&P 500 and Nasdaq each down less than three-tenths of a percent. The S&P 500 dropped marginally a day after its record high close. Shares of chipmakers dropped, with investors nervous about high valuations of AI-related stocks. Broadcom shed about 6%, while shares of Intel lost 2%. The declines come despite a sharp August rebound for semiconductors. But Brad Conger, chief investment officer at Hirtle & Co., remains cautious on the sector. "On the semiconductors, what we're seeing is a very supply constrained market where gross margins are now in the mid-80s, which is extraordinary. It's something we've never seen before for these companies. And it really just shows you how severe the supply shortages are in that market. The market seems to be very comfortable that supply shortage is going to persist and that those margins are going to maintain. I think, again, that's a very fragile equilibrium that, in other words, one announcement about a CapEx plan or a new entrant to the market like we saw with this Chinese chip maker called CXMT can really throw the narrative to the other side." Among other AI-related stocks, Applied Materials shed about 5% after the company's upbeat quarterly forecast failed to impress investors. The chip equipment maker's shares have doubled in 2026 due to strong demand related to the buildout of AI data centers. Elsewhere in the market, shares of Reddit surged almost 13% after the social media company was named a new addition to the S&P 500 index, effective August 18. And shares of Workday dipped nearly 4%. This comes a day after they soared 18% as Reuters reported that private equity firm Silver Lake was in talks to acquire the software firm. :: Archive Meanwhile, transit through the Strait of Hormuz appeared at a near standstill after two more ships were attacked, adding to pessimism about a peace deal with Iran. Oil prices rose more than one dollar a barrel. And economic data on Friday showed retail sales in July fell for the first time in nine months, and consumer sentiment slumped in early August amid worries about the rising cost of living.

chineseTitle: 由于投资者权衡数据和中东紧张局势，华尔街收低
chineseSummary: 视频显示：无故事：美国股市周五收低，道琼斯指数、标准普尔 500 指数和纳斯达克指数均下跌不到十分之三。标准普尔 500 指数在创下历史新高收盘后的第二天小幅下跌。由于投资者对人工智能相关股票的高估值感到紧张，芯片制造商的股价下跌。博通 (Broadcom) 股价下跌约 6%，英特尔 (Intel) 股价下跌 2%。尽管半导体市场在 8 月份出现大幅反弹，但仍出现下滑。但 Hirtle & Co. 首席投资官布拉德·康格 (Brad Conger) 对该行业仍持谨慎态度。 “在半导体方面，我们看到的是一个供应非常有限的市场，毛利率现在在 80 年代中期，这是非同寻常的。对于这些公司来说，这是我们以前从未见过的。这确实表明了该市场供应短缺的严重程度。市场似乎对供应短缺将持续存在以及这些利润率将保持下去感到非常满意。我再次认为，这是一种非常脆弱的平衡，换句话说，就是关于资本支出的一项声明计划或市场新进入者，就像我们在这家名为长鑫存储的中国芯片制造商身上看到的那样，确实可以将故事推向另一边。”在其他人工智能相关股票中，应用材料公司因乐观的季度预测未能给投资者留下深刻印象而下跌约 5%。由于与人工智能数据中心建设相关的强劲需求，这家芯片设备制造商的股价将在 2026 年翻一番。在市场其他地方，自 8 月 18 日起社交媒体公司 Reddit 被纳入标准普尔 500 指数后，其股价飙升近 13%。Workday 股价下跌近 4%。此前一天，路透社报道私募股权公司 Silver Lake 正在洽谈收购这家软件公司，股价飙升 18%。 :: 归档 同时，过境
